content:
[L] high | center of screen, between conversation list and reading pane | a wide dead white band (~480px) sits between the list column and the conversation content, serving no purpose and breaking the three-column grid.
[L] high | bottom of reading pane | the customer message card is cut off mid-sentence ("Hey there,") by the reply composer, which overlaps the conversation scroll area instead of sitting below it.
[L] high | top-left views rail | a solid black rectangle overlays the top of the views rail, colliding with the "Views" label area and reading as a rendering artifact.
[S] high | reading pane | the reply composer's width does not match the message thread above it — the thread card extends wider than the composer, so their left/right edges are not aligned.
[C] high | conversation list column | roughly 60% of the list panel is empty white space below the two rows while the reading pane is crushed, an extremely unbalanced composition.
[C] med | right side of reading pane header | the "Closed", "Copilot", and circular-icon controls float far right with a huge gap from the title/metadata block, unanchored and ungrouped.
[S] med | list header | the search input, "#" tag-filter button, and black "Apply" button have inconsistent heights and the Apply button sits detached to the far right with uneven gaps.
[S] med | list header second row | "Filters", "Reset", and "Sync now" are scattered across the row with arbitrary spacing — Reset floats mid-row with no visual grouping to Filters.
[H] med | conversation list rows | sender name, subject, "Unassigned", and "Closed" badge all compete at similar visual weight; no clear primary line vs metadata hierarchy.
[H] med | "Conversation" details card | Status/Assignee/Priority/State/Tags rows are label-left/value-right but values are loose chip clusters with no grouping, making the card read like a debug property inspector.
[L] med | details card, Status row | the chip group (active/pending/closed/spam) sits flush against the label with tight, inconsistent gaps compared to the Assignee row below.
[S] med | date divider "2026-10-16" | the divider floats between the details card and message card with uneven whitespace above and below and inconsistent width relative to the cards.
[C] low | details card | the card has no parent panel context — it floats on gray background directly attached to the header, inconsistent with the bordered message card below.
[H] low | message header | "Amy Fraughton", "Customer", and the timestamp are three different styles at slightly different baselines, mixing identity, role, and metadata at equal prominence.
[C] low | left rail bottom | "Closed 2" ends mid-panel with a large empty region below, while the list column stretches full height — vertical proportions unmatched.
[S] low | composer footer | "reply — sent to the customer · Ctrl+Enter sends" and the black Send button sit at opposite ends with the hint text nearly touching the textarea border.
[H] low | composer To/Cc/Bcc | label column widths and input field left edges are aligned, but To field is filled/read-only while Cc/Bcc show placeholder text at the same weight, blurring state.

VERDICT: unprofessional — broken column grid, overlapping composer clipping content, a rendering artifact in the rail, and massive dead zones make this read as a prototype, not a product.
